  "ferramenta": "image_gen integrada",
  "referencia": "Captura anotada do rio enviada pelo usuário; peixe desenhado usado como guia de proporção.",
  "prompt": "Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the user's attached annotated garden videogame screenshot directly to create one visual review sample. Preserve the original framing and wide aspect ratio, background garden, fence, girl, fairy, water surface height and EXACT THREE ROCK PLATFORM TOP positions, heights and widths. Remove ALL blue drawn annotations, arrows and blue fish doodle; the drawn fish is only a size guide. MAIN REPAIR: each of the three existing stone platforms must be the top of a CONTINUOUS SOLID NATURAL ROCK PILLAR growing upward from the lake bed. Extend the existing rock bodies downward seamlessly through the waterline and all the way down into a visible subtle lakebed at bottom of frame. No floating boulders, no tapered reflection masquerading as physical support, no disconnected cap atop narrow manufactured columns. Natural irregular grey stone outcrops, solid broad stone columns with cracks, subtle moss on exposed upper portions, slightly wider irregular anchored bases among small lakebed pebbles. Center column taller because original top is higher; keep all top elevations intact. Render submerged stone portions visible under translucent turquoise water, tinted blue-green and softened by depth, with tiny surface ripples wrapping around actual pillars. Add a FEW SMALL COLORFUL FISH, about four or five scattered sparsely in the open underwater spaces BETWEEN pillars, warm orange, gold, muted pink and blue, slender freshwater fish silhouettes with small fins, approximately the user's little doodle scale, each much smaller than girl's height, around one quarter to one third of her height at most. Fish visibly submerged, painterly and subtle, not giant cartoon characters, no human expressions. Add SPARSE delicate aquatic plants rooted in lakebed near pillar bases and edges: a few short fine ribbon leaves and little stems, minimal coverage and low contrast. Keep generous uncluttered open water; no dense aquarium jungle, coral, seaweed forest, bubbles everywhere, dramatic caustics or big lily pads. Water remains calm blue-turquoise, with enough transparency to show pillars anchored in lakebed at bottom. Natural hand-painted storybook illustration matching original game, not photorealistic. This is a proposed screenshot edit only; no text, no labels, no UI, no new platforms, no annotations. Preserve girl and fairy completely.",

  "estado": "Amostra visual solicitada, aguardando avaliação. Sem integração ao jogo."
